We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: Zhang stole a phone with a knife, then the next day, Gu (谷某某) knowingly bought the phone, aware it's stolen, and was caught. The prosecution says Gu's behavior constitutes "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪" (concealing/covering up criminal proceeds). So the crime is "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪". Possibly also "非法持有、买卖盗窃所得物品"? But typical Chinese criminal law: Article 322 (concealing or hiding stolen property) is "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪". So answer: [罪名]掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪<eoa>.

That was "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得,犯罪所得收益". But here only Gu is buyer, not the thief. So only concealment. So answer single crime.
